name: dsh-ui-css-patches
description: Local persistent Web UI CSS patches, merged from dsh-code-card-fonts / dsh-rightbar-fonts / dsh-rightbar-tab-width / dsh-fullwidth-chat into one stylesheet and one lifecycle: full-width conversation column, fixed-width dockkit tabs, right-bar preview/changes-review font scale, and 14px conversation-card titles/summaries/content/code/tables plus calc(14px * 0.5) message-card spacing. Anchors are stable data-* attributes and CSS variables only (no positional :nth-child / :has() guessing); the co-located check-css.mjs + css-contract.json verify those upstream tokens after every build.
